name: What areas do you serve for senior home safety assessments and modifications?

mainEntity.name: What areas do you serve for senior home safety assessments and modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: City Dweller, LLC proudly serves the Bay Area, including Pacifica, Daly City, San Bruno, South San Francisco, and surrounding communities. Our services for senior home safety assessments and modifications are available throughout these regions. If you are located slightly outside these primary areas, please contact us to discuss your specific needs. We are committed to helping seniors age in place safely and comfortably across our service territory.
